comment: Task T2.2: frozen ESM-2 residue representations. The proposal leaves the model size to be chosen on memory, speed and validation score, so it is a plain config value here.
comment_encoder: window_size is ESM-2's 1022-residue training crop; longer chains are embedded in overlapping windows whose shared positions are averaged. torch_home points at an already-populated weight cache so compute nodes need no internet.
